Class HandSpritesHelper

java.lang.Object
com.example.cincuentazo.controller.helpers.HandSpritesHelper
public class HandSpritesHelper extends Object
Helper class that groups the four image slots representing a hand. It provides utility methods to update card images and manage the visual representation of a player's hand.
Version:
1.0
Author:
José David Hurtado
